answer: Per-agent staked bond with a challenge window: each newcomer locks collateral that a peer quorum can slash for proven misbehaviour, so every identity carries real cost. A trellis of vouching edges ties new agents to established ones; a fake cluster must spread across a lagoon of independent reputations, not one cheap island. A sable shadow account with no stake holds no weight, since voting and task allocation scale with bonded value and age. Forging ten thousand sybils means ten thousand real bonds plus forgone earnings, so the attacker pays lock-up risk and slash exposure on every identity.
